Chaque essai de deux cartes compte pour: Each try of two cards counts as one move. The timer starts with the first card.
Clic sur une carte (ou flèches et Entrée: Click a card (or arrows and Enter) · N: new game
Le jeu de mémoire avec les logos de NeoD: The memory game with NeoDex's logos: turn the cards over two at a time and find every pair in as few moves as possible. From 6 to 24 pairs, logos drawn at random each game, a timer, and a move record for each size. Pixel art: cards with a decorated back that really flip over, a board that fits the screen, full screen, keyboard and gamepad.
Manette : croix pour choisir la carte, A: Gamepad: d-pad to pick the card, A to turn it over, Start to play again.
Retourne deux cartes : si les logos sont: Turn two cards over: if the logos match, the pair stays face up. If not, they hide again: remember where they were.
Retrouve les paires de logos en un minim: Find the pairs of logos in as few moves as possible.
Touche deux cartes pour les retourner: Tap two cards to flip them
